title: Synapse bilingual medical microlearning content pack
description: Validation schema and policy annotations for traceable English-Persian medical microlearning packs derived from the user-provided harrison-sim corpus.

sourceProfile.classification: user-provided simulated reference; never represented as the commercial textbook
sourceProfile.fileAccounting: Every file under an in-scope Part or Chapter must appear in sourceDocuments, including indexes, chapter and lesson Markdown, supplemental Markdown, all structured sidecars, contributors metadata, and media.
sourceProfile.sidecarBoundary: Structured sidecars are parsed with a strict non-executing AST allowlist and treated as derived candidates. Their find, summary, quiz, or enrich filename never grants medical authority or creates a separate authoring phase.
sourceProfile.scaffoldSupersession: The historical hierarchy-only scaffold release stays immutable and body-free. Content packs created under this contract are later releases and cannot mutate that scaffold in place.

sourceMapping.Lesson directory: source container and segmentation evidence, one-to-many into units, clusters, micro-lessons, and sessions
sourceMapping.Heading: candidate boundary only
sourceMapping.Source detail atom: smallest coverage unit; never a learner-facing node by itself

rules: Course and Chapter identities retain the ordinal UUIDv5 lineage already defined by the curriculum importer.
A source Lesson directory is never silently discarded, but it does not force a long user-facing lesson.
Units and Concept Clusters are editorially reviewable groupings; Micro-lessons, Sessions, and Interactions are the learner-facing progression.
A split or merge creates explicit supersession edges and migration; an approved ID is never silently reused.
Every spatial Path node has an ordered semantic equivalent.

identityVersioningAndHashes.nodeIdentity: project UUIDv5 namespace plus approved ordinal lineage; locale, title, path, hash, and release are excluded
identityVersioningAndHashes.sourceDocumentIdentity: source corpus key plus ordinal lineage plus artifact role; bytes are versioned by rawSha256
identityVersioningAndHashes.sourceAtomIdentity: sourceDocumentId plus parserVersion plus AST locator plus atom ordinal; edits create a new atom version and explicit reconciliation
identityVersioningAndHashes.semanticUnitIdentity: locale-neutral editorial ID shared by English and Persian
identityVersioningAndHashes.interactionAnswerIdentity: option IDs and semantic answer keys, never translated option positions
identityVersioningAndHashes.canonicalJson: UTF-8 JSON canonicalized with RFC 8785 before SHA-256
identityVersioningAndHashes.textHash: UTF-8 NFC text with LF line endings; do not strip medically meaningful punctuation, symbols, units, or whitespace inside formulas
identityVersioningAndHashes.sourceByteHash: SHA-256 over original bytes before decoding or canonical media transforms
identityVersioningAndHashes.secrets: Generator metadata may contain provider/model/task/session IDs and hashes, but never API keys, cookies, credentials, prompts containing secrets, or local absolute paths.

atomization: Parse all files before authoring and classify every document by role and authority.
Split prose into claim-sized semantic atoms; preserve paragraph context as a separate atom when it changes interpretation.
Represent every heading, list item, table header and cell, formula, threshold, warning, footnote, cross-reference, caption, panel label, and meaningful media reference.
Keep exact locators and hashes so a reviewer can jump from an authored claim back to the source detail.
Group duplicates but account for every duplicate source atom individually.
fullCoverageLedger.nonInstructionalExclusion: Only navigation noise, decorative artifacts, or verifiably non-instructional boilerplate may be excluded. The source atom, reason, and human coverage review remain mandatory; no medical fact may use this disposition.
fullCoverageLedger.conflictHandling: When the corpus conflicts with current authoritative evidence, preserve coverage by teaching the discrepancy and current status; never erase the source atom or silently repeat the outdated claim.

deepStudyDocument.answerIsolation: Study blocks cannot reuse option, rubric, why-correct, why-wrong, or feedback localization units.
deepStudyDocument.provenanceScope: Localization provenance must be a subset of its Block; Block provenance a subset of its Document; Document provenance a subset of its Micro-lesson.
deepStudyDocument.revealSafety: Attempt- or completion-gated blocks name one Session in the same Micro-lesson and expose no hidden heading or body before the gate is satisfied.

microlearningBudgets.budgetRule: Both English and Persian estimates must pass. A locale cannot be shortened by deleting semantic units; split the session instead.

splitWhenAny: The topic changes enough to require a new learner objective.
A causal mechanism chain exceeds seven meaningful links.
A list contains more than five independent items that each need explanation or retrieval.
A table has more than six instructional rows or more than four comparison dimensions.
A media item has more than three instructional panels or independent pattern-recognition targets.
The session exceeds any locale duration, concept, claim, interaction, passive-step, or monotony budget.
A management, dosing, contraindication, or safety cluster requires a distinct evidence version, jurisdiction, or review boundary.
The learner must master a prerequisite before the next idea can be understood safely.
neverSplitBy: English sentence boundaries imposed on Persian
The legacy find, summary, quiz, or enrich filenames
splitRules.continuity: Every split records prior/next concept links, prerequisite IDs, and source-atom ranges so the learner experiences a coherent path rather than disconnected fragments.

activityAndAssessmentDesign.sequenceRule: A session targets the smallest justified span of the ladder; it does not pretend that one exposure proves higher-order mastery.
activityAndAssessmentDesign.embeddedQuizPolicy: Retrieval and quiz interactions are distributed inside learning, repair, application, and checkpoint sessions. There is no mandatory separate quiz-writing phase or fixed 15-to-30-question dump.
activityAndAssessmentDesign.assessmentCoverage: Every major concept and every clinical-high or safety-critical claim must be assessed at least once before chapter validation and scheduled for delayed retrieval; not every source atom needs its own question.
questionRules: Questions assess taught claim IDs unless explicitly diagnosticOnly; diagnostic items cannot punish mastery or grant competence claims.
Use four or five choices only when the interaction benefits from choices; prefer constructed responses when cueing would trivialize retrieval.
Every correct answer has a mechanism or reasoning explanation.
Every distractor has a misconception ID or explicit plausible-error rationale and a complete why-wrong explanation.
No placeholder, trick wording, irrelevant trivia, answer-length cue, or invented fact is allowed.
Clinical vignettes are short, synthetic, de-identified, clinically purposeful, and use demographics only when relevant.
A second attempt changes representation or context instead of repeating the same item verbatim.
activityAndAssessmentDesign.summaryBoundary: Recaps and debriefs are retrieval-oriented reinforcement. They may not introduce unsupported claims, replace primary instruction, satisfy coverage alone, or become a separate content-enrichment pipeline.
activityAndAssessmentDesign.varietyRule: No interaction family should exceed half of a session unless accessibility adaptation requires it; the same template cannot appear more than twice consecutively.

bilingualSemanticAlignment.fallbackForPublishedLessonBodies: none; missing Persian or English blocks the pair
bilingualSemanticAlignment.authoring: English and Persian are authored in the same task from one locale-neutral semantic skeleton. Persian is a native pedagogical adaptation, not a word-for-word translation or a later bulk pass.
parityInvariants: Same semantic unit ID, claim IDs, source atom IDs, concept IDs, numbers, units, evidence, interaction intent, option IDs, answer key, scoring, safety flags, and mastery target.
Different sentence count, information order, analogy, and idiom are allowed when meaning and cognitive demand remain equivalent.
A medical term is linked to one terminology ID; Persian first mention explains it naturally while preserving the standard English or Latin term when useful.
Semantic skeleton hashes are recomputed from locale-neutral fields and must match both variants.
Numeric values are stored structurally in canonical ASCII form and rendered by explicit policy; locale never changes the value, unit, comparator, decimal precision, or answer evaluation.
persianRules: Use natural modern Persian, Persian ی and ک, correct half-spaces, and a warm but professionally credible register.
Do not copy English syntax, force slang, or hard-code a single form of address into every lesson.
Isolate Latin terms, formulas, IDs, URLs, drug names, ECG lead names, and units as LTR runs.
Persian UI and prose are RTL, but ECG traces, anatomy laterality, radiology orientation, formulas, plots, and fixed scientific directionality never mirror.
Native Persian and medical review are separate required approvals.
bilingualSemanticAlignment.reviewGate: A published pair requires English editorial review, Persian native-language review, medical parity review, placeholder parity, answer-key parity, and real RTL accessibility proof.

provenanceAndMedia.bidirectionalTraceability: Every output claim links to source atoms and required evidence; every instructional source atom links to at least one primary or mechanism representation.
provenanceAndMedia.citationGate: A citation is valid only when its locator resolves, date/version is recorded, the cited passage supports the linked claim, and the content hash was captured. Generated citation strings are never accepted as evidence.
mediaRules: Magic bytes and successful bounded decode override file extension.
No absolute source path enters a distributed pack.
Every used asset has rights state, raw and canonical hashes, transform history, caption, bilingual alt text, accessible equivalent, educational purpose, and medical review.
Decorative medical stock imagery does not satisfy a learning need and is excluded from content packs.
Generated medical illustrations are labeled by origin and require accuracy review; a visually attractive but anatomically uncertain image is rejected.
Pattern-recognition media must include a nonvisual alternative without pretending text is equivalent to visual mastery.

claimRequirements.clinical_low: corpus provenance, claim-level review, and explicit scope
claimRequirements.clinical_high: current authoritative source, version/date/jurisdiction, medical review, and uncertainty/limitation
claimRequirements.safety_critical: multiple-source or designated-primary-source verification, independent medical approval, forced recency review, and withdrawal path

hardStops: Locale mismatch in dose, threshold, comparator, unit, answer, warning, or contraindication
Outdated time-sensitive claim presented without status
Patient-specific recommendation or hidden clinical-decision-support behavior
Unreviewed generated medical image or media label
clinicalSafetyAndEvidence.recovery: Quarantine the smallest safe release unit, preserve the finding and prior version, withdraw any activated channel pointer when necessary, repair, independently re-review, revalidate, and publish a new immutable version.

promotionWorkflow.raw: Complete source inventory, deterministic atoms, draft hierarchy, bilingual authored units, interactions, generator provenance, and no user availability.
promotionWorkflow.reviewed: Coverage reviewer, medical reviewer, English editor, Persian native reviewer, and accessibility reviewer have resolved all blocking findings on the exact artifact hash.
promotionWorkflow.validated: Schema, references, hashes, coverage, parity, evidence, micro-budgets, monotony, assessment, safety, accessibility, rights, and pack-consumer checks pass with zero blocking findings.
promotionWorkflow.published: A publisher distinct from the author activates an immutable validated release through a channel pointer. Publication never edits content in place.
promotionWorkflow.separationOfDuties: Generator, author, medical reviewer, native-language reviewer, and publisher identities are recorded; author and publisher must differ, and a generator cannot approve.

chapterAcceptance: Every in-scope source file and atom reconciles exactly.
Every approved Micro-lesson and Session passes both locale budgets.
Every published Micro-lesson has exactly one bounded primary Deep Study document whose ordered blocks load in the real Study Workspace.
Every major concept and high-risk claim appears in the assessment blueprint and delayed-retrieval plan.
No learner-facing content depends on a separate summary, quiz, or enrich mode to become complete.
The compiled pack loads in the real content consumer and preserves deterministic IDs, order, and hashes.
The raw-to-published reconciliation accounts for every record added, changed, quarantined, superseded, or excluded.

adoptedPrinciples: Read every relevant source file before authoring.
Preserve full source coverage while teaching why and how.
Explain terminology at first meaningful use.
Use purposeful clinical vignettes and media explanations.
Give complete why-correct and why-wrong feedback.
Reject placeholders and validate content quality beyond syntax.
explicitlyExcluded: Any legacy product name, narrator persona, folder naming, TypeScript output shape, or fixed voice formula
A separate specialist or enrich authoring workflow
A separate summary-generation phase that can replace source coverage
A separate bulk quiz file or fixed question-count mandate
Provider-specific research commands or platform operating instructions
Arbitrary patient-name rules, forced vignettes, forced images, or forced cross-links
adaptationBoundary.providerNeutrality: This contract governs the artifact produced and validated. External task orchestration belongs to the platform skill and may not weaken any content gate.
